observations: Three photos show multiple insulated vacuum thermos bottles with attached cups, in various colors: pink, black, white, purple, and light pink.
Each thermos has a stainless steel lid and base, with a colored middle section and a matching wrist strap.
Photo 2 shows a thermos pouring liquid into a small stainless steel cup, with text overlay 'Thermos for Hot Drinks' and 'Cup Includes'.
All photos have a watermark: 'POSTED ON JJI MAIRAHEXPRESS STORE'.
No brand or model name is visible on any thermos in any photo.
The thermos in photo 2 appears to be 600ml/20.5oz as claimed, based on size relative to the cup and standard thermos proportions.

Photo 2 explicitly shows the cup next to the thermos with text 'Cup Includes'.

risks.proof: A video showing the thermos holding hot water for 12 hours or cold water for 24 hours, with temperature readings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as average insulation performance, not premium

risks.risk: The cup may not be securely attached or may leak
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the cup attached to the thermos, showing the seal and how it detaches.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially leaky or loose-fitting cup

risks.risk: The material may not be food-grade stainless steel or may contain harmful coatings
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the interior of the thermos and cup, showing the material and any labels or markings.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the interior of the thermos and cup to verify material and safety markings.
Video showing the thermos holding hot water for 12 hours or cold water for 24 hours.

response.reason: The item is clearly an insulated vacuum thermos with cup, as described. The size and features are supported by the photos. While some performance risks exist (insulation, leaks, material safety), these are common to all such products and do not prevent pricing. The item can be priced at its worst-case performance until further proof is provided.
